A signed direction means through the centre and the counter-direction it has not selected. The pole's local definiteness therefore carries a relation; it does not have to wait for a later reconciliation to acquire one.

The return first meets the determination at the point where it claims to be sufficient. The materialist one takes the manifest mark as the whole of reality. What returns is the condition the mark excluded from its account, and it enters first as a break in the mark's own reckoning. The achieved one turns toward that ground as its own division: `1/0`. The finite expression encounters the condition that cannot be made into another finite expression. Sym-ballein defines towards wholeness by retaining that encounter; a claim to possess wholeness would close the return it names.

The complete computational pulse is **divide / relate / recombine / return**. Recursive division makes subproblems tractable because their answers can be recomposed. If the capacity to combine is retained privately while everyone else remains divided, division becomes a means of governing the gap. Turning those means into further objects does not make their aggregate the Subject to whom the investigation appears.

A faithful definition makes a positive account of what it names and includes the act by which that account is made. Its fidelity lies in the relation it performs: the determination discloses its source through a finite form, while remaining answerable to what that form cannot possess. The defining act belongs to the reality being defined. It cannot acquire an outside position merely by describing that reality more completely.

A [determining cut](C03-Determination.md) makes what is named distinguishable from its alternatives. The question is what the cut does to its own conditions. When God names the whole in which the defining takes place, or Subject names the one for whom the distinction appears, treating the referent as one further bounded object changes its office. A more elaborate object-description repeats that change. Adding the sentence “this description is incomplete” does not repair it if the account continu

The definition must therefore make its own implication consequential: this is the account, this is the act of accounting, and the latter has not disappeared into the former. It does not need an impossible inventory of every condition. It needs to preserve the determining relation through the determination it makes.

Draft 3 gives this pressure a bodily exactness: **“a fish trying to describe water while swimming in it.”** The sentence about the whole is another event within the whole. Its inability to occupy an exterior is not a missing observation that one more sentence would supply. The [formal limit](../arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) recurs when an additional representation attempts to capture the condition of representing: this further sentence is itself made within that condition.

A [living symbol](C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md) gives a determinate disclosure through which its source can still answer; an idol requires the source to answer to its achieved image. The window has a particular frame; fidelity does not require removing the frame. It requires the account to let through what it frames, including what changes the terms under which it was first approached.

[Commitment through time](../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) puts the definition at risk in a continuing relation: [reliance](C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) must receive the consequences and corrections which its use brings back. Naming a limit is not yet risking a relation; fidelity requires that what returns can matter to the account and to the one who gives it.

Even an account that describes the entire movement remains an account. Draft 3 makes the next turn explicit: the fourth position still speaks *about* God; first-person recognition changes the register. The one attempting the definition recognises its own implication in what was being defined. Recognition makes a consequence unavoidable: describing answerability cannot substitute for becoming answerable.

The self-opening thought is therefore not a weak definition. Draft 3 calls it **“a determinate proposition built to carry its own negation as cargo.”** [Open conceptuality](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE.md#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q022) carries the determination through affirmation, negation and the relation which keeps both available. The negation carried here concerns the proposition's pretension to finality. The account remains responsible

The first distinction has two faces. It identifies something and makes the difference by which it can be identified. Saying “this” selects from a field while holding enough continuity for the selected instance to be recognised again. The [copula](../arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) relates a name to this instance in this circumstance, preserving identity through their difference. To determine positively is also to exclude. What falls outside the selected term helps give it a boundary, even when the account does not name what it has excluded. “Not selected” cannot therefore mean “irrelevant to how the selection was made.”

Measurement makes a further commitment: a unit, comparison or ratio renders a difference reckonable. A [ratio](../arguments/A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account.md) compares determinate quantities through their stated relation. Precision belongs to the stated relation; it cannot promote a chosen measure into the source of everything it measures.

An account of a selection becomes another selection. The [achieved form cannot absorb the act now accounting for it](C04-Formal-Limit.md): this further selection reproduces the determining relation. The successful distinction remains; its determining condition has not become its possession.

The [tattvic contraction](../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) turns unbounded powers into determinate capacities. Measure gives the contraction its positive work. Limitation supplies determinate capacity, knowledge, desire, time and order; it does not merely subtract pieces from an otherwise complete subject.

A **paradigm** is a lived organisation of finite disclosure: a historically, psychically, materially and technologically formed pattern through which a Life encounters a World as intelligible and actionable. Māyā gives this relation its anatomy of revealing and withholding; the paradigm is one determinate organisation of that mediation. Changing a paradigm means changing what becomes salient, possible and consequential, not merely replacing a professed description of the world.

The contraction leaves its source operative. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti; the power of veiling is itself manifesting power. Māyā is therefore the horizon through which objects appear, not a hidden object behind the horizon and not the unobjectifiable Subject. Treating the horizon as the torus's hole would confuse the measure-making operation with the source it cannot enclose.

This is also why the paradigm can veil its own disclosing act without becoming a merely false screen. A functioning mediation presents a world by making some relations salient, possible and actionable while others recede. The concealment belongs to the disclosure's finitude. Integral recognition does not abolish the horizon; it makes the horizon increasingly available **as horizon**.

The arithmetic gives the comparison an operation more precise than a matching total. It does not show that Abhinavagupta constructed the tradition by adding a geometrical gnomon, or that every tattva has been mapped to a six-by-six coordinate. The extended field makes source, contraction and the possibility of return explicit: the twenty-fivefold apparatus acquires a genealogy through the five pure powers, the Māyā hinge and the five contracted powers. Arche-Topos names the differential field of place-making: the relation through which positions, poles, paths, centres and horizons become determinate. It answers the question of where a relation can take form before an observer and object have each been assigned a place. The field's operation cannot be captured by placing one more object inside it.

The [Quaternal relation](C11-Quaternal-Logic.md) keeps generation, inversion and return available within the same determining movement. Logical seam, excluded alternatives and the finite horizon are different refractions of the place-making operation. Their difference is retained: an epistemic exclusion is not a physical distance and a tattvic contraction is not a coordinate transformation merely because each helps locate an act.

The `180°→360°` articulation distinguishes perspectival wholeness and contextual co-presence. It does not promise a perspective which sees everything. A [change in containing relation](C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) makes further positions readable without requiring one projection to absorb the rest.

The universal plane cover is infinite, not two-sheeted. These formal objects make the [circulation](../arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) exact: surface closure can retain a displacement in the cover, and independent windings preserve different routes. A phase-space models possible states; a trajectory is a particular history; an attractor and its basin organise dynamical motion. An atlas instead coordinates local disclosures and their transition relations. A chart is not an attractor and the world is not its phase-space model.

These are authorial Mytheme operations, not empirical claims that all surveillance, AI or political institutions instantiate one mechanism. Each application needs its own evidence. The common argument is formal: **the office which represents, measures or mediates becomes protected when the life it represents can no longer effectively return upon the criterion by which it is represented.**

The inherited **Antichrist field** gives this operation its darkest symbolic name: **counterfeit sourcehood**. A representation, criterion, institution or mediating image has real derivative power; the failure begins when it no longer answers to the source and lives it mediates and instead requires those lives to answer to its image of them. “Anti-” here is not used as a free-standing etymological proof or a label for disliked technology. It names the authorial mythic pattern in which the image

The Antichrist operation therefore cannot be diagnosed by the presence of mediation alone. Every functioning paradigm mediates. A legal category, model, image, interface or institutional office may be indispensable. The question is whether its local achievement remains legible as **local and derivative**, or whether it becomes the condition under which every challenge to its own scope is heard. Whoever answers — vendor, operator, user, the agent itself — is determining a composite their own expectations, tools and permissions already help constitute. The brief states the double register: an "Agent" "is not simply what it appears to be, and what it appears to be is not what it is" — a decomposable assemblage of model, persona, harness architecture, memory, skills, permissions, tools, whose cohere

A faithful definition names the actual assembly and keeps its determining relations inside the account rather than hiding them behind a persona.

Its excluded condition returns as the mark's own division, `1/0`: the determination encounters a ground it cannot calculate as one further result. Holding that break retains the `/0` beneath the one. This technical return concerns what an actual organisation can preserve and revise. The arithmetic inability at `1/0` remains the native formal seam; a failed synthesis is not by itself division by zero. The shared operation is the achieved result becoming answerable through a condition it did not contain.
